verdict.rationale: Nix's official Nixpkgs repository advertises over 140,000 packages, with `nix search` for discovery and binary caches so packages download pre-built instead of compiling. Independent users confirm that most apps listed as Homebrew-only are in Nixpkgs and that people use Nix to get package versions their distro lacks. Community reports also note that obscure packages sometimes need self-made variants or wrapping, maintainers are stretched thin, and one security patch took about two days to merge. missing for 10: documented evidence of maintenance cadence and update freshness, and assurance that niche or obscure packages are covered and configurable without custom packaging.
